To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the SACE-CSCWs tool is a system that allows users to work in a common environment, in different time modes, with different roles and different views of the same information.

the proposed system prototype can provide a common environment that allows the participants of a decision making meeting to work with a variety of cooperation modes, and that this system can provide a framework that can be used in different domains.
the SACE-CSCWs is a system that supports the decision making process by providing a synchronous asynchronous common meeting environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new generation of CSCW tools that are capable of supporting the decision making process in a cooperative way.
the development of an environment for supporting the cooperation and collaboration of people in the decision making process of Concurrent Engineering.
the design of a system that provides computer support to a decision making meeting, in order to help the participants to achieve their goals in a more effective and efficient way.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this paper is an important contribution to the field of Computer Supported Cooperative Work (CSCW) and to the Concurrent Engineering (CE) field.
the system is a useful tool to support meetings and the cooperation/collab-oration processes.
the system prototype is a useful tool to support decision making meetings and it is a step forward in the construction of a complete Concurrent Engineering system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SACE-CSCWs is a system that provides a common environment for CSCW to aid concurrent engineering.
we have constructed a framework that provides computer support to the different modes of cooperation that are possible in meetings and that we have implemented the framework in Java.
we are trying to construct a framework to aid the design process in a concurrent engineering environment.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a new generation of CSCW tools is needed to support the new requirements of the concurrent engineering processes and that the new generation of CSCWs should not only support synchronous and asynchronous cooperation but also other modes of cooperation such as group/sub group, user roles, and public or closed type, anonymous or nominated, full view, partial and single view.
a common framework can be used for supporting different modes of meetings in different domains.

the SACE-CSCWS system is a tool to support the cooperation of the participants in meetings and it can be used as a part of the Concurrent Engineering environment to support the decision making process.
